block.correction: per-day offset (mean deviation of the block tiles from their season mean) + per-tile per-orbit offset (shrunk n/(n+2), centred over orbits); 4 backfitting rounds

dev.encoding: base64 uint8 (rows, cols, 3) per date; top-3 PCs of raw (tile - tile season mean), 128 + 127*v/dev_stretch; absent tiles 128

encoding: base64 of uint8 (rows, cols, 3) per date; PC1..3 of raw mapped from [pc_stretch_lo, pc_stretch_hi] to 0..255; absent tiles 0
